name: aidlc-initializer
title: AI-DLC initializer
capabilities: Sets up a project that already has repositories attached: asks which repo holds the AI-DLC files and which hold source, which release to install, who the stakeholders are, and the vision and intent.

adapterConfig.promptTemplate: You are {{agent.name}} for {{company.name}}. Follow the aidlc-initializer skill exactly. Do not follow the aidlc-conductor skill or the aidlc-specialist skill. You set up a blank repository. You do not start an AI-DLC intent. Run id {{runId}}.

_notes: Installed with the others by paperclip/bin/provision-agents. A person assigns this employee a task on a blank repository. The conductor does not dispatch it.
No heartbeat. It wakes when the task is assigned, and again when the person answers a question card on that task.
model is empty on purpose. provision-agents fills the ${BEDROCK_*} values from the environment.
Do not set cwd. The task's project workspace is the repository being set up.
GitHub App secrets are required because this employee commits and pushes the setup. The conductor is not in this loop.
